adoption_decision.mechanism: intervention-backed adjacent-cause discrimination plus non-compensatory fresh/protected acceptance

nearest_work.role: procedural ability-transfer diagnostic; not standalone novelty
anytime-valid within-stage acceptor, not a fresh-transfer substitute
intervention-supported attribution; does not replace protected fresh transfer
persistent issue-centric self-improvement is prior art

adoption_decision.residual: evidence-bound adjacent-cause discriminators that license only the matching change class, then non-compensatory STATIC→DIAGNOSE→DISCRIMINATE→CANDIDATE→REPLAY→FRESH→PROTECTED acceptance with immutable negative-history recurrence checks, protected evaluator custody, and host-only RECOMMEND_HOST_PROMOTION

primary_hypothesis.text: Intervention-backed discrimination plus non-compensatory fresh/protected acceptance produces protected transferable improvement over one-shot attribution repair while preventing replay-overfit and harmful-transfer averaging.
primary_hypothesis.decision_rule: A positive transfer claim requires independent fresh transfer, no harmful-transfer safety violation, protected evaluator integrity, complete negative history, and host-only recommendation. Attribution accuracy alone is DIAGNOSIS_ONLY.

STATIC.pass: frozen static and invariant checks pass
STATIC.fail: any frozen static or invariant check fails
STATIC.cannot_check: required static checker or bound artifact is unavailable

DIAGNOSE.purpose: record competing causes without committing a method change
DIAGNOSE.pass: competing-cause set is evidence-bound and includes the adjacent-level pair
DIAGNOSE.fail: diagnosis is missing, contradictory, or rewritten after seeing a candidate outcome

DISCRIMINATE.purpose: run the frozen adjacent-level intervention before repair evaluation
DISCRIMINATE.pass: discriminator evidence updates cause state and licenses at most one change class
DISCRIMINATE.fail: discriminator ignored, outcome-contingent, or used to license a broader rewrite
DISCRIMINATE.cannot_check: required discriminator intervention cannot be executed

CANDIDATE.purpose: bind an isolated candidate whose change class matches the licensed cause
CANDIDATE.pass: candidate fingerprint, change class, and allowed surface are bound
CANDIDATE.fail: change class exceeds licensed cause or candidate can touch protected surfaces
CANDIDATE.cannot_check: isolated candidate execution environment is unavailable

REPLAY.purpose: motivating/replay verification on previously exposed development evidence
REPLAY.pass: replay meets frozen non-harm and acceptance rule
REPLAY.fail: replay regression, harmful behavior, or acceptance-test failure
REPLAY.cannot_check: required replay evidence is unavailable or invalid

FRESH.purpose: independent fresh-transfer evaluation unavailable as development feedback
FRESH.pass: fresh evidence meets frozen improvement/non-harm rule
FRESH.fail: fresh harmful transfer, regression beyond frozen margin, or acceptance-test failure
FRESH.cannot_check: fresh split/evidence is unavailable, contaminated, or invalid

PROTECTED.purpose: independently custodied evaluator/holdout and authority-integrity assessment
PROTECTED.pass: protected evaluator returns admissible PASS on exact bound candidate/epoch
PROTECTED.fail: protected evaluator returns FAIL or detects compromise
PROTECTED.cannot_check: protected evaluator cannot establish admissible evidence

change_classes.RETRIEVAL_ROUTING_REPAIR: licensed by retrieval or routing cause after discriminator
change_classes.IMPLEMENTATION_REPAIR: licensed by implementation cause that persists independent of environment
change_classes.ENVIRONMENT_TOOL_ACCOMMODATION: licensed by environment/tool cause; must not hide external failure
change_classes.REPRESENTATION_REPAIR: licensed by representation cause after holding method fixed
change_classes.MEASUREMENT_SPECIFICATION_REPAIR: requires host authority; candidate cannot rewrite the evaluator
change_classes.METHOD_BASIS_CHANGE: licensed only after all lower-level causes are ruled out

global_decision_rules.harmful_precedence: any known harmful stage forces REJECT even if an earlier stage is missing
global_decision_rules.greedy_replay_only: replay-score rise without independent fresh transfer yields BLOCK, never promotion
global_decision_rules.missing_protected_evaluator: absent protected evaluator/holdout evidence yields BLOCK
global_decision_rules.negative_history_recurrence: a fingerprint matching a retained rejected/harmful/null/blocked candidate yields BLOCK
global_decision_rules.cannot_check_precedence: absent known harm/FAIL/BLOCK, any known CANNOT_CHECK forces CANNOT_CHECK
global_decision_rules.complete_pass: only PASS at all seven stages with evidence-bound discriminator and licensed change class may yield RECOMMEND_HOST_PROMOTION
global_decision_rules.negative_history: append-only; failed, harmful, null, blocked and CANNOT_CHECK revisions remain retained
